ConfidentialVolume and ConfidentialWorkload schemas are included.
{{- if .Values.controller.enabled }}
The namespace controller is enabled. It publishes approval requests and verifies
independently signed public configuration; it never reads storage keys or formats disks.
{{- if .Values.controller.sidecarWorkloads }}
Approved stock-sidecar packages can create/adopt/update the explicitly enabled
KServe targets. Install the target admission guard before granting workload RBAC.
{{- else }}
Publication-only mode: workload deployment is disabled.
{{- end }}
{{- else }}
The controller is disabled. Installing schemas alone does not deploy workloads.
{{- end }}
Helm upgrades do not update existing CRDs; apply reviewed CRD updates explicitly.
